description: This header file defines interfaces and constants for the xdiff library, including functions for diff computation, reading files and blobs, binary detection, and configuration. The file also contains typedefs for callbacks used in diff output processing.

methods.name: xdi_diff
methods.description: Computes the differences between two memory-mapped files using specified parameters.

methods.name: xdi_diff_outf
methods.description: Outputs the diff between two files using provided callback functions for hunks and lines.

methods.name: read_mmfile
methods.description: Reads a file into a memory structure.

methods.name: read_mmblob
methods.description: Reads binary object data into a memory structure.

methods.name: buffer_is_binary
methods.description: Checks if the buffer contains binary data.

methods.name: xdiff_set_find_func
methods.description: Sets a custom function to find specific strings/phrases in diff output.

methods.name: xdiff_clear_find_func
methods.description: Clears any custom find function set previously.

methods.name: parse_conflict_style_name
methods.description: Parses the style name for merge conflict markers.

methods.name: git_xmerge_config
methods.description: Configures merge strategies according to git configuration.

methods.name: xdiff_compare_lines
methods.description: Compares two lines with specific flags affecting whitespace handling.

methods.name: xdiff_hash_string
methods.description: Generates a hash value from a string with specified whitespace flags.

ctags.name: xdiff_emit_hunk_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(void * data,long old_begin,long old_nr,long new_begin,long new_nr,const char * func,long funclen)
